archetypes.name: dyn-runlog-dedupe
archetypes.rationale: Run-log warning dedupe now depends on matching flush chunk keys and source hashes.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the architectural-guidelines append helper for exact parity with run-log flush chunking, redaction, and warning dedupe behavior. Pay special attention to markdown-section parsing, ndjson RUN_ID resolution, and duplicate detection when notes contain multiple bullets. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
